In this video, I break down 7 ways marketing specialists use Claude every day to create better campaigns, write content faster, and improve productivity with AI. You'll learn how to use Claude for real marketing tasks, discover practical Claude marketing workflows, and see why Claude for marketing is becoming an essential tool for marketers and business owners. This hands-on Claude tutorial also shows how to use Claude AI for content creation, market research, copywriting, and campaign planning, helping you get the most out of Claude in 2026.
